Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: polished BIOFARM Russian ecommerce website design proposal, version 3. Reference image is the previous concept for brand continuity; improve it substantially. Flat, straight-on high resolution UI presentation, no perspective, no devices. Strong art direction: warm ivory #F8F8F2, rich forest #20523A, primary #27683F, pale sage panels, restrained amber accents. Large modern geometric sans headings of normal weight 400, dark readable body, airy but purposeful spacing, consistent 16-24px corner radii. Alternate bright commerce with dark forest editorial sections. Distinctive close-up botanical photography and brown glass jars with black lids and cream minimal labels, real-looking photographic shadows. Reduce ornamental floating leaves and remove cursive scribbles/dotted swirls. Strong clean alignment, refined buttons, useful metadata, attractive magazine-like hierarchy. Header BIOFARM/БИОФАРМ with Каталог, Производство, Блог, Партнёрам, search and cart. CRITICAL user exclusion: NO favorites, NO favorite hearts, NO bookmark/save buttons, NO share icons or buttons, NO words Избранное or Поделиться anywhere. No admin or account pages. No invented medical efficacy promises or fabricated company metrics. All interface text Russian, crisp and correctly spelled. Photographic reviews are illustrative product snapshots, not portraits. Never crop off bottom controls.
Create one complete tall desktop homepage, maximum useful resolution, aspect 1:3. Ordered sections:
1) minimal header, large asymmetric hero "Природа Сибири. Забота каждый день." left, premium jar still life right; CTA "Смотреть каталог", supporting "Растительные экстракты БИОФАРМ".
2) six compact category tiles, simple non-heart icons; "С чего начнём заботу?"
3) "Популярные продукты": four product cards, image, title, "130 г", old crossed price and bold price, "В корзину". First "Экстракт коры осины", 912 ₽, old 2 600 ₽, badge −65%. Other products keep modest believable typography, not unverified efficacy.
4) dramatic deep green production feature "От сырья до готового продукта": warm laboratory/botanical photograph, prominent circular VIDEO PLAY button, short copy and "О производстве".
5) quality and certificate previews, compact three cards.
6) editorial blog three wide photographic article cards with category and date.
7) "Отзывы покупателей": three spacious white cards in sage section, initials avatar, name, product name, stars, short text. Crucially EACH card has TWO OR THREE real-looking attached product photo thumbnails (jar held in hand, parcel, label detail). Bottom prev/next arrows and pagination dots. These are attached review images, not face avatars.
8) adjacent bonus and marketplace panels: bonuses, Wildberries, Ozon.
9) generous partnership form panel "Растём вместе": intro and four short benefit lines left, complete form right. Four separate visible fields with labels ABOVE them: "Ваше имя *", "Телефон", "Email *", large textarea "Сообщение *". Fullwidth button "Отправить заявку". Below "Нажимая кнопку, вы соглашаетесь с политикой конфиденциальности". Do NOT reduce form to two inputs, do NOT add checkbox. Give this section enough height.
10) contact section with address/hours/email roles without fabricated contact details; green footer navigation including delivery/payment/returns/documents/legal. Must fit all sections fully.
